conn.title: Connect to a server
conn.lead: The server address and the application port: they are shown in Settings → Connection and in the installation summary.
conn.fp.title: Server certificate fingerprint
conn.fp.hint: Compare it with the fingerprint in Settings → Connection or in the installation summary. The application remembers it and accepts only this certificate from now on.
conn.fp.changed: The certificate of this server has changed. If you did not change it yourself, do not connect: the connection may be intercepted.
conn.err.unreachable: The server does not answer at this address.
conn.err.pin_mismatch: The server certificate does not match the remembered fingerprint.
login.title: Sign in
login.remember: Remember the password in the keychain
dash.empty: No servers yet. Connect the first one with the agent: the command is shown by the installer.
dash.err: Could not load the list of servers.
term.title: Terminal
term.limit: The terminal limit of this server is reached.
